clips.title: The story
paras: Menethil Harbor links the Eastern Kingdoms to Kalimdor from its island off the Wetlands' western shore. Stone battlements and Menethil Keep's towers guard the port, where merchants, off-duty soldiers, and salty adventurers gather.

Menethil Harbor honors King Terenas Menethil II of Lordaeron and offers the Alliance a haven on the Wetlands coast. Its remote marshland setting leaves it exposed, so massive walls, a single bridged causeway, and Menethil Keep's four stone watchtowers guard the town.

Menethil Harbor is a crossroads for Alliance ships crossing the ocean to Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh and, by way of Southshore, Auberdine in Darkshore. The ships carry trade and diplomats, while off-duty Kul Tiran marines spend their wages at the Deepwater Tavern. Peace remains fragile. The Dragonmaw clan contests inland supply paths through Dun Algaz, and Dark Iron raiders press the northern marshes. Captain Stoutfist and the harbor garrison stay on constant alert.
